packageRules.description: AbroadWorks fork posture (Phase 0 baseline): never auto-merge anything. The auto-merge gate per aw-notetaker canonical design doc §14 #14 is aw-output-adapter integration tests, deferred to Phase 1; until they exist, all PRs require manual review. §14 #20 separately mandates manual triage of transitive vulnerability bumps (prefer upstream Vexa patches over local).
Group GitHub Actions bumps to one PR.
Group Dockerfile base image bumps to one PR.
Group Python transitive dep bumps to one PR (covers requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, requirements.in, poetry).
Group npm dep bumps to one PR.
